title: Position embeddings initialized without 2D spatial information
description: The position embeddings at initialization carry no information about the 2D positions of the patches, and all spatial relations between patches must be learned from scratch during training.
canonical_description: position embeddings initialized without 2D spatial information must be learned from scratch
